description:
FILED s514f (Opus, 2026-10-11) while probing #2920.  PRE-EXISTING on main 8f2fa11c.

`print STDOUT (LIST)` -- a parenthesised list after a bareword handle -- dies in PCL:

    print STDOUT (*2, "\n");
perl 5.40.3: *main::2
PCL:         Undefined subroutine &main::STDOUT called

PCL reads `STDOUT (...)` as a call to sub STDOUT.  perl reads the handle (the parens are the list).  Probe also `print STDERR ("a", "b")`, `print FH ("x")` after open(FH,...), and `printf STDOUT ("%s\n", 1)`.  Fix site: PExpr's print filehandle decision -- a Structure::List after a bareword handle shape is the list, unless the word is a declared sub (then perl calls it; see #3182).


=== FOLDED into #2193 (s519a) ===
The duplicate of #2193: fixed by commit 6435a5f1, see #2193s DONE section.
subject: print STDOUT (LIST) dies 'Undefined subroutine &main::STDOUT' -- the bareword handle before a parenthesised list is read as a call
